snippet.title: Supra Mayro 64 Fan Made | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
An updated trailer for the Mayrotastic and Award-winning GOTY game, Supra Mayro 64 Fan Made! 

Join Mayro in his epic 3d adventures and help him to fsave the Princes Pesh from the Kingo Booser!

Get da game here now:
https://gusvenga.itch.io/supra-mayro-64-fan-made#download

Works on: Windows, Android, macOS and Linux.

This epic game is also open source!
https://github.com/GusvengaNew/Mayro64FM

Just a note, the game was originally made and first available for download in 2020, but the full v1.0.0 release was in late 2021.

#mayro #supramayro #gus #fangame #adventure #android #windows #cuteanimemoments
